title: Senior Financial Analyst – General Ledger & R2R (CA/ CMA preferred)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Accounting and Finance professional to join Oracle’s Global Accounting Controllers (GAC) team.

In this role, you will support accurate and timely monthly and quarterly financial close activities for assigned countries, perform general ledger and balance sheet reconciliations, resolve outstanding accounting items, and support financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting policies and US GAAP requirements.

You will collaborate with global stakeholders, contribute to accounting process improvements and automation initiatives, support audits and system upgrades, and serve as a key contact for country- or region-specific accounting matters.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

1. Financial Close & General Ledger Management: Execute monthly and quarterly financial close activities, prepare and review journal entries, and maintain accurate general ledger records for assigned countries.

2. Balance Sheet Reconciliation & Accounting Accuracy: Perform periodic balance sheet account reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve outstanding open items to support accurate financial statements.

3. Financial Reporting & Compliance: Support the preparation and analysis of financial reports, including profit and loss and balance sheet statements, while maintaining compliance with applicable accounting policies and US GAAP requirements.

4. Data Center & Intercompany Accounting: Support data center accounting activities and relevant accounting processes, including fixed assets, intercompany transactions, and associated financial reconciliations.

5. Audit & Internal Controls: Provide documentation and analysis for internal and external audits, ensure journal entries meet applicable control requirements, and contribute to maintaining accounting procedures.

6. Global Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with finance teams and stakeholders globally to support consistent close management, reporting, and financial data practices. Act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned regional or country-specific projects and issue resolution.

7. Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve accounting efficiency, reconciliation quality, and financial close processes. Participate in global projects, cloud-based automation initiatives, and testing of system upgrades or process changes.

8. Knowledge Sharing & Team Development: Support the onboarding and training of new team members, share accounting knowledge, and contribute to effective team collaboration.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

### **Mandatory**

Educational Qualifications & Experience

Candidates must meet one of the following qualification pathways:

* Qualified CA/CMA with 3–6 years of relevant experience in Accounting and Finance.
* B.Com, M.Com, CA/CMA Inter, or MBA with 8+ years of relevant experience in Accounting and Finance.

Technical & Functional Competencies

* Hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, journal entries, and month-end or quarter-end financial close.
* Experience performing balance sheet reconciliations, investigating variances, and resolving outstanding accounting items.
* Understanding of financial accounting, financial statements, and financial reporting processes.
* Ability to support accounting activities and maintain accurate financial records in a controlled financial reporting environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for accounting and reconciliation issues.

Professional & Behavioral Competencies

* Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to work with geographically distributed teams and global stakeholders.
* Self-driven, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
* Team-oriented working style and commitment to financial accuracy, integrity, and responsible stewardship.

### **Good-to-Have**

The following are relevant differentiators described in the original JD, but their mandatory status has not been established:

* Experience with US GAAP accounting and reporting in a multinational environment.
* Exposure to data center accounting, fixed assets, or intercompany accounting.
* Experience supporting internal or external financial audits.
* Participation in global finance transformation or accounting process improvement projects.
* Experience with accounting automation, cloud-based financial systems, or system upgrade testing.
* Experience serving as a regional or country accounting SPOC.
* Experience training or onboarding new team members.

**Self-Assessment Questions**
-----------------------------

* Do I meet one of the specified education and experience pathways for this role?

* Do I have hands-on experience executing month-end or quarter-end financial close activities, including journal entries and general ledger accounting?

* Have I independently performed balance sheet reconciliations, investigated variances, and resolved outstanding accounting items?

* Am I confident interpreting financial statements and supporting accurate accounting and reporting activities?

* Can I collaborate effectively with global stakeholders while maintaining strong accountability for accounting accuracy and deadlines?

title: Analyst, Accounting Shared Services Centers
description:
Job Description:

**Job Summary**

The Intercompany Accountant is responsible for managing and reconciling intercompany transactions across group entities, ensuring timely month-end close, accurate financial reporting, and compliance with accounting policies. The role involves ownership of intercompany balances, Goods in Transit (GIT), Netting and Allocation Processes (NAP), Hold Accounts, AP/AR reconciliations, and GRIR analysis while collaborating with global stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Intercompany Accounting**

* Manage end-to-end intercompany accounting processes across multiple legal entities.
* Ensure timely recording, validation, and settlement of intercompany transactions.
* Prepare and post intercompany journal entries in compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
* Investigate and resolve intercompany mismatches and reconciliation differences.
* Coordinate with regional finance teams to clear aged outstanding balances.

**Goods in Transit (GIT)**

* Perform monthly review and reconciliation of Goods in Transit balances.
* Analyze aging items and collaborate with logistics, supply chain, and business teams for timely resolution.
* Ensure accurate recognition of inventory and corresponding intercompany entries.
* Monitor open transit transactions and support period-end reporting requirements.

**NAP (Netting and Allocation Process)**

* Execute intercompany netting activities and settlement processes.
* Validate netting positions and ensure proper allocation of balances between entities.
* Investigate exceptions and discrepancies in netting cycles.
* Support cash settlement and treasury teams during intercompany settlements.

**Hold Account Management**

* Review and reconcile hold/suspense accounts on a periodic basis.
* Analyze unidentified transactions and coordinate with stakeholders for proper classification.
* Ensure timely clearance of outstanding hold balances and maintain supporting documentation.
* Drive reduction of aged items through regular follow-up and escalation.

**Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly AP and AR intercompany reconciliations.
* Reconcile sub-ledger balances with general ledger accounts.
* Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, and booking discrepancies.
* Work with global counterparts to achieve intercompany balance alignment before close.
* Ensure compliance with account reconciliation policies and SOX/internal control requirements.

**GRIR (Goods Receipt Invoice Receipt)**

* Review and reconcile GRIR accounts on a monthly basis.
* Analyze aged GRIR items and coordinate with Procurement, Operations, and AP teams for resolution.
* Monitor unmatched goods receipts and invoices.
* Ensure accurate accruals and timely clearing of open GRIR balances.
* Support audit requests by providing detailed reconciliation and supporting documents.

**Month-End Close Activities**

* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.

title: Accounting Operations Analyst
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

### **Analyst, Revenue Accounting**

**Reports to:** Senior Manager of Revenue Accounting

  
**What will you contribute?**

You will be part of the team that keeps our revenue accounting running accurately every single day. This is a hands-on, operational role at the heart of how we account for customer contracts under IFRS 15 — and it's where strong revenue accountants build their foundation. You will do the essential work that everything else depends on: setting up and maintaining revenue contracts in the ERP system, preparing reconciliations, and producing the accurate detail that feeds our reporting and audits.

Much of this work is operational and process-driven, and a lot of it is currently manual — which means your accuracy, consistency, and reliability genuinely matter. You will become an expert in how our revenue processes actually work end to end, which is exactly the grounding that leads to a successful career in revenue accounting. As you grow, you'll have the chance to take on more and to contribute ideas for doing the work better.

**Responsibilities & Deliverables**

* Set up and maintain customer revenue contracts in the ERP system, accurately reflecting the accounting treatment provided to you.
* Prepare account and contract reconciliations for revenue, accrued income, and deferred income, flagging differences for review.
* Execute the operational, day-to-day tasks of the revenue accounting cycle, including manual processes that require care and consistency.
* Prepare journals and supporting schedules for the monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue close.
* Prepare supporting documentation and gather information to help respond to audit queries.
* Follow established processes and controls accurately, and escalate questions or anything unusual to senior team members.
* Help maintain clean, well-organized records that support a strong control environment.
* Contribute to making our processes better — sharing ideas and supporting improvement and automation efforts as the team evolves.

**Required Experience**

* Around 2 years of experience in accounting, ideally with some exposure to revenue or operational accounting.
* A solid grounding in core accounting principles; awareness of revenue recognition or IFRS 15 is helpful but not essential.
* Strong attention to detail and a genuinely careful, consistent approach to repetitive and process-driven work.
* Well-organized, reliable, and able to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
* Comfortable working with systems and spreadsheets, and willing to learn our ERP and reconciliation tools.
* A proactive attitude and willingness to learn, ask questions, and grow within a structured team.
* Studying toward a recognized accounting qualification is a nice to have.
Experience using Oracle NetSuite ERP or Blackline is a nice to have.

title: Finance Manager – Investor Relations and Fund Operations
description:
**About Prana Ventures**

Prana Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm investing through SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds. We back founders at the earliest stages and work closely with them through the life of the company. Behind every investment is a finance function that has to be accurate, on time and fully compliant, and that is the team you would be joining.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Finance Manager to manage investor relations and run the fund accounting & operations engine across our funds and the management company. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will own investor reporting, day-to-day delivery of fund accounting, capital calls and distributions, investment fund flows, regulatory and tax compliance, management company finance, working with our fund administrator, auditors, tax advisors and legal counsel.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not a review-only one. You will prepare, reconcile and run the processes yourself, bring them to the Head of Finance for sign-off, and be the person the partners, LPs, administrator and auditors rely on for the numbers. It suits a Chartered Accountant/ Commerce graduate who already understands how a fund works end to end and wants to build depth in venture capital.

**Key responsibilities**

**Investor reporting and relations**

* Own the end-to-end quarterly and annual investor reporting cycle, including LP reports, capital account statements, portfolio updates and fund performance metrics (IRR, TVPI, DPI and MOIC), bringing together inputs from the investment team and the fund administrator.
* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for LPs on queries relating to capital accounts, drawdowns, distributions, tax statements and fund performance, and ensure every response is accurate, consistent and timely.
* Manage LP onboarding and investor records, including subscription and contribution documents, KYC/AML and FATCA/CRS documentation, the investor register and the LP portal or data room.
* Prepare financial packs and materials for LP meetings, annual investor meetings and Investment/Advisory Committee meetings, and track follow-up actions to closure.
* Respond to LP due diligence questionnaires (DDQs) and other ad-hoc reporting requests, and maintain a tracker of side-letter obligations to ensure they are consistently honoured.
* Support the partners in fundraising for new funds by preparing track-record data, financial information and data room materials, and by responding to prospective investors’ queries.

  

**Fund accounting and reporting**

* Run fund accounting and NAV computation for each fund in coordination with the fund administrator, and review the administrator’s output for accuracy before it goes to the Head of Finance.
* Prepare quarterly and annual financial statements, LP reports, capital account statements and portfolio valuation summaries within agreed timelines.
* Maintain the master record of investments, follow-on rounds, exits and write-offs, and reconcile it to the administrator’s books every quarter.
* Support portfolio valuation exercises in line with the applicable valuation guidelines (including IPEV) and the fund’s valuation policy, and prepare materials for valuation review.

  

**Capital calls and distributions**

* Prepare and issue capital call and distribution notices; track LP commitments, contributions, unfunded amounts and recallable capital.
* Reconcile LP receipts, follow up on delayed contributions and escalate any potential default to the Head of Finance and partners in line with the fund documents.
* Compute management fees, fund expenses, carried interest and waterfall distributions in accordance with the fund documents, and maintain the supporting workings for audit.

  

**Investment operations**

* Coordinate fund flows for new investments, follow-ons and exits, including wire instructions, KYC, FEMA compliance and closing documentation, working with the investment team and legal counsel.
* Maintain the fund’s shareholding and investment tracker for each portfolio company, including instrument terms, conversion events and liquidation preferences.
* Support the investment team with financial diligence inputs and post-investment monitoring data where required.

  

**Compliance and regulatory**

* Ensure timely and accurate regulatory filings and reporting, including SEBI AIF filings, FEMA/RBI reporting for foreign LPs and investments, and any other statutory returns applicable to the funds and management company.
* Manage tax compliance for the funds and management company, including withholding tax, advance tax, tax returns and LP tax documentation, in coordination with tax advisors.
* Lead the annual statutory and tax audits for the funds and management company: plan the timeline, prepare schedules, respond to auditor queries and close out findings.
* Maintain the compliance calendar and ensure no filing or payment deadline is missed.

  

**Management company finance**

* Manage bookkeeping, accounts payable, expense management, payroll coordination and budgeting for the management company.
* Track fund expenses against management company expenses and ensure allocation is correct and consistent with the fund documents and LP expectations.
* Prepare monthly management accounts and cash-flow forecasts for the management company.

  

**Process, systems and controls**

* Document and continuously improve finance processes, controls and checklists so that every recurring deliverable is repeatable and audit-ready.
* Own the finance systems and data, including the accounting system, LP records and investment trackers, and drive improvements in reporting and automation.

  

**What success looks like in the first 12 months**

* Quarterly LP reports and capital account statements go out accurately and within the agreed timeline every quarter.
* LPs receive prompt, accurate responses to their queries, and investor onboarding, DDQs and side-letter reporting are handled smoothly without escalation.
* All SEBI, RBI/FEMA and tax filings are made on time with no penalties or notices.
* Statutory and tax audits close on schedule with no material findings.
* Capital calls, distributions and fee computations are issued without errors or restatements.
* Finance processes are documented, controls are in place, and the Head of Finance can rely on your work with light-touch review.

  

**What we are looking for**

**Must-haves**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant/ B.Com
* 4-6 years of experience in investor reporting, fund accounting, fund administration, audit or finance operations in VC, PE or asset management.
* Working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, FEMA and related RBI reporting, and Indian tax provisions applicable to funds and their investors.
* Hands-on experience with capital calls, distributions, management fee and carried interest calculations and waterfall mechanics.
* Experience preparing investor-facing reports and handling LP queries, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with accounting software and fund administration platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of delivering accurate work against fixed deadlines.

  

**Nice-to-haves**

* Prior experience in-house at a VC or PE fund manager, or at a fund administrator serving AIFs.
* Exposure to IPEV valuation guidelines and portfolio valuation processes.
* Experience with offshore fund structures and foreign LP onboarding.
* Familiarity with ILPA reporting templates and LP reporting portals.
* Big 4 or reputed mid-tier audit background with fund or financial services clients.

------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

The Finance Accounting team builds the accounting foundation behind Rippling’s Finance products. We help customers turn the activity happening across spend, procurement, reimbursements, and other finance workflows into accurate, auditable data in their ERP.

This is a high-leverage product area where accounting infrastructure, ERP connectivity, and AI automation meet. The team’s work spans the full lifecycle of financial data: helping customers configure accounting rules, validate transactions before they post, recover when syncs fail, and ultimately close their books with more confidence and less manual work.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Product Lead to lead Finance Accounting at Rippling. You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance products and help define the future of accounting automation on top of Rippling’s platform.

Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will build the accounting infrastructure, workflows, and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve complex enterprise Finance customers. Second, you will help create a new generation of AI-powered accounting workflows that automate manual close work — from validating transaction coding and configuration readiness, to recovering failed syncs, reconciling activity, and preparing adjustments.

Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. That gives us the context to automate work accountants perform manually today and to build an accounting product that can become a major platform in its own right.

**What you will do**

* Set the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Accounting, with a clear point of view on how Rippling should help finance teams translate their operational activity in Rippling into accurate accounting outcomes.
* Build the core accounting platform behind Rippling’s Finance products, including the workflows customers use to configure rules, map data, post to their ERP, and resolve issues when syncs fail.
* Design product experiences that give accountants confidence in the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of their books.
* Lead the development of AI-assisted accounting workflows that help customers validate transactions, identify exceptions, recover from failures, and reduce manual close work.
* Partner deeply with engineering and design to turn complex accounting and integration problems into intuitive, reliable product experiences.
* Spend time with customers, implementation teams, support, accounting experts, and ERP partners to understand where accounting workflows break down and where the product can remove friction.
* Define how Rippling should support enterprise customers and their unique needs, like multi-entity setups, tax and currency needs, and high expectations for controls and reporting.

**What you will need**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy.
* Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure.
* A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them, or the ability to quickly develop fluency in them.
* The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems.
* Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand.
* High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building accounting, ERP, fintech, or financial operations products.
* Familiarity with systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience with month-end close, reconciliation, transaction coding, or financial integrations.
* Experience building AI agents or AI-powered workflow products.
* Experience building products for controllers, accountants, or enterprise finance teams.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively between internal teams and external banking partners.
* Experience working with financial reporting systems and working alongside technology teams for process improvements.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks with tight deadlines.

description:

Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.  
  
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.  
  
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
- Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.  
- Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.  

* Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.

- Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.  

* Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
* Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
* Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.

No two days look the same when the automated-abuse landscape shifts in real time - your week balances hands-on investigation, strategy, and close ML partnership to keep Anti-Automation ahead of emerging threats:  
  
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)  

* Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action.
* Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
* Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.

  
Strategy (Building What's Next)  
- Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.  

* Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.

* Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
* Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
* Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.

  
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)  

* Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
* Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.

  
About the team  
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.  
  
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job is responsible for preparing complex tax returns and provisions with precision while reviewing the work of junior staff to ensure accuracy and completeness. It supports audits and communicates with tax authorities as needed. The role contributes to maintaining strong compliance by applying technical expertise and assisting with tax research or issue resolution.
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Prepare complex returns and provisions with a high degree of accuracy.
* Review tax filings prepared by junior team members.
* Support audits and interactions with tax authorities.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


**Subsidiary:**


PayPal
**Travel Percent:**


0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us.


For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.


**Our Benefits:**


At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.


**Who We Are:**

  


**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.


**Belonging at PayPal:**


Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.


Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.


We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Bring more to life.**

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today: time to get life\-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.


We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300\+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

  

It’s all part of our time\-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935\. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

**Job SUMMARY:** The Sr. Financial Analyst is responsible for providing financial insights and projections to facilitate decision\-making to the Commercial Leaders. This role involves analyzing financial data, preparing reports, and developing financial models to support strategic planning and operational efficiency.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Lead the preparation of the annual budget and monthly forecasts by working with the commercial leaders in the region
* Analyze variances between actuals, budget, and forecast, and explain key drivers for Top Line and Bottom Line.
* Prepare detailed monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and models for revenue, costs, headcount for senior management and highlighting key metrics and trends.
* Develop Monthly KPI’s Management Reports and Dashboard
* Partner with functional leaders (Sales, Operations, Accounting and Sales Ops) to gather financial data and understand business drivers.
* Drive Cost Control Measures in the region and Sustain the Operating Margins as per the Budget and Forecast
* Review Pricing for each product and monitor and provide insight into pricing to the General Manager and drive price increase initiative.
* Ensure Revenue Recognition Process is followed as per the Rev Rec Policy and Partner with accounting team on revenue recognition review process as required.
* Review of Sales Incentive and ensure correct accruals and payouts in line with the compliance as per the Beckman Financial Policy
* Collaborate with Accounting team and drive Satisfactory rating on BEC LS Internal Audits in in the region.
* Review of Demo Assets ageing and ensure the Demo Policy is followed for each transaction.
* Support ad\-hoc financial analysis and projects as required by senior management.
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal policies.
* Good Team Member and work collaboratively with the cross functional team.


**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA from Top B Schools/CA /CMA preferred.
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, preferably in a corporate environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
* Proficient in financial modeling and advanced Excel skills.
* Experience with financial planning software and ERP systems (e.g. Oracle, OBI and EPM) is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey financial concepts to non\-financial stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* High level of integrity and ethical standards.
* Strong leadership and team management abilities.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.


Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Botsync is Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We're a Singapore\-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. We design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots, including our MAG series, that handle material movement at scale so humans can focus on higher\-value work.


As Botsync scales deployments, expands internationally, and prepares for Series\-B fundraising, this role builds and owns the company's financial, accounting, legal, and investor\-facing backbone. Twelve months in, success looks like clean, audit\-ready financials across all entities with strong cash runway visibility and improved working capital cycles, smooth execution of Series\-B fundraising and investor diligence, a robust legal and compliance framework with minimal founder dependency, and a finance function built to scale with Botsync's global ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Financial strategy and leadership**
* + Own Botsync’s financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning
	+ Build and maintain multi\-entity, multi\-country financial models across hardware, software, and services
	+ Provide the CEO and Board with clear financial insights, unit economics, and cash runway visibility
	+ Drive capital efficiency, margin improvement, and working capital optimization
* **Accounting, controls and compliance**
* + Own end\-to\-end accounting operations across all entities (Singapore, India, Australia, and others), ensuring monthly, quarterly, and annual closes are accurate and on time
	+ Manage statutory audits, tax filings, GST/VAT, transfer pricing, and regulatory compliance
	+ Establish and maintain strong internal controls, approval matrices, and financial SOPs and reporting automation
* **Legal, governance and fundraising**
* + Act as the internal owner of all legal and corporate matters, coordinating with external counsel on shareholder agreements, ESOPs, customer contracts, and vendor agreements
	+ Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, cross\-border regulations, and board governance; support board meetings, resolutions, cap tables, and statutory filings
	+ Lead financial preparation for Series\-B and future fundraising rounds, owning investor data rooms, financial models, projections, and due diligence coordination
	+ Work with the CEO on investor conversations, term sheet analysis and negotiation, cap table and dilution planning, and act as a key point of contact for existing investors, VCs, and strategic partners
* **Banking, treasury and team building**
* + Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions; structure and negotiate working capital lines, bank guarantees, trade finance, LC facilities, and FX hedging
	+ Own cash management, treasury operations, and risk mitigation, including monitoring currency exposure across multi\-country operations
	+ Build and lead a high\-performing finance and accounting team, mentoring finance managers across regions
	+ Implement scalable processes suitable for enterprise customers and global audits, and act as a trusted finance partner to Sales, Operations, and Product teams

  

**Requirements** **Essential**

* 10–15\+ years in finance leadership roles, ideally within VC\-backed startups or hardware \+ SaaS / deep\-tech / industrial companies
* Proven ownership of company\-wide finance and accounting across multi\-entity, multi\-country operations
* Direct experience leading fundraising and investor interactions, including Series\-A / Series\-B rounds
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition for hardware, software, and services, working\-capital\-heavy business models, and cross\-border taxation and compliance
* CA / CPA / CFA or equivalent qualification

**Highly desirable**

* Experience setting up ESOPs, share buy\-backs, and vesting frameworks, and exposure to manufacturing, robotics, or industrial automation

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment
